title.en: How do I simulate survey data?

description.en: Generate annual input tables or full operating-model replicates, retain truth, and choose the right simulation pathway.
description.zh: 生成年度输入表或完整操作模型重复，保留真值，并选择适合问题的模拟流程。

title.en: How do I fit my own survey data?
title.zh: 如何拟合自己的调查数据？

description.en: Import a workbook, check its structure, specify supported biological assumptions, fit ALSCL and inspect the results.
description.zh: 导入工作簿、检查数据结构、指定有依据的生物假设，拟合 ALSCL 并检查结果。

title.en: What can a fit to a real survey be used for?
title.zh: 真实调查数据的拟合结果，哪些可以用？

description.en: Fit ALSCL and ACL to the North Sea whiting index of 1983-2026, read the starts and the numerical checks, and compare the fit with age readings and with the ICES assessment.
description.zh: 用 1983-2026 年北海牙鳕调查指数拟合 ALSCL 和 ACL，读多个初值的结果和数值检查，并与年龄判读结果和 ICES 评估对比。

title.en: Do ACL and ALSCL give different answers?
title.zh: ACL 与 ALSCL 的评估结果有什么不同？

description.en: Fit both model structures to the same synthetic observations and examine numerical diagnostics, residuals and population estimates.
description.zh: 对同一组模拟观测拟合两种模型，检查数值诊断、残差及种群估计。

title.en: Do estimates change when recent data are removed?
title.zh: 移除近期数据后，估计结果会怎样变化？

description.en: Refit successively shorter time series and interpret retrospective trajectories and Mohn’s rho.
description.zh: 逐次截短时间序列并重新拟合，解释回溯轨迹与 Mohn rho。

title.en: How sensitive is the assessment, and what happens under future F?
title.zh: 评估对假设有多敏感，未来 F 会怎样改变结果？

description.en: Compare M and shared-F assumptions on the same data, profile a free parameter, and project explicitly defined future F scenarios.
description.zh: 对同一份数据比较 M 与共享 F 假设，对自由参数做剖面，再投影假设明确的未来 F 情景。

title.en: Can the fitted model reproduce observations and predict withheld time steps?
title.zh: 模型能重现观测并预测留出时间步吗？

description.en: Simulate observations from fitted ACL/ALSCL models, refit retained truth, and test predictions on time-held-out data.
description.zh: 从拟合的 ACL／ALSCL 模拟观测，保留真值重新拟合，并用按时间留出的数据检验预测。
